title: Hitting time from the target
statement: Let $G$ be a finite $D$-regular multigraph with $D>0$, and let $t$ be a vertex. For each $j$, let $q_j(t,t)$ be the probability that a walk of $j$ steps starting at $t$, choosing each step uniformly from the $D$ indexed neighbors, avoids $t$ at every visited vertex, including its endpoint. For every integer $N\ge 0$, $\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}q_j(t,t)=0$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite regular multigraph of degree $D$
